content: [{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"OWASP Top 10 Deep Dive: A Technical Guide for Ethical Hackers"},{"order":2,"type":"paragraph","text":"The OWASP Top 10 is a standard awareness document that represents the most critical security risks to web applications. For ethical hackers and penetration testers, mastering these vulnerabilities is essential for identifying critical flaws before malicious actors exploit them."},{"order":3,"type":"subheading","text":"1. Broken Access Control (A01:2021)"},{"order":4,"type":"paragraph","text":"Access control enforces policy such that users cannot act outside of their intended permissions. Failures typically lead to unauthorized information disclosure, modification, or destruction of data."},{"order":5,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Insecure Direct Object References (IDOR): Attackers manipulate parameters based on user input to access resources directly."},{"order":6,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Missing function level access control: API endpoints lacking proper role verification."},{"order":7,"type":"code","text":"GET /api/v1/user?id=105 HTTP/1.1\nHost: vulnerable-site.com\nCookie: session_id=attacker_session_token"},{"order":8,"type":"subheading","text":"2. Injection Vulnerabilities (A03:2021)"},{"order":9,"type":"paragraph","text":"Injection flaws, such as SQL, NoSQL, OS, and LDAP injection, occur when untrusted data is sent to an interpreter as part of a command or query. The attacker's hostile data can trick the interpreter into executing unintended commands."},{"order":10,"type":"code","text":"SELECT * FROM users WHERE username = 'admin' OR '1'='1' AND password = 'password';"},{"order":11,"type":"subheading","text":"Remediation and Defensive Strategies"},{"order":12,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Implement Principle of Least Privilege across all IAM systems and database roles."},{"order":13,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Use parameterized queries and Object Relational Mappers (ORMs) to naturally defend against SQL injection."},{"order":14,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Enforce robust multi-factor authentication and validate access control tokens server-side on every request."}]
